feature: Faster pallet SO search and compact customer results
setup: Existing Node, Playwright, fast-check, c8, ESLint and TypeScript only. No dependencies, migrations, commits or credential changes. Use the bounded disposable test runner and preserve unrelated workspace/live changes with an app-only overlay and rollback.
scenarios: P1 Pallet-only SO lookup reads the current order header/customer without loading product descriptions, pricing, units or packing conversions. Stock lookup retains complete lines.
P2 Closed orders retain their existing per-line fulfillment check. Pending, partial and cancelled orders fail before reading the pallet balance. Unknown orders and malformed references fail safely.

P3 Every SO enquiry and submission still reads fresh balance data; customer identity, local reservations, credit reconciliation, cross-yard pallet acceptance and stock yard restrictions are preserved.
U1 One or a few customer matches remain compact and top-aligned at phone, tablet and desktop sizes. A long result list remains scrollable and selectable.

O1 Compare read-only live lookup timings and result identity; report NetSuite variability without promising a fixed response time. Keep concise audit evidence and remove all disposable test resources.

failureModel.incorrectEligibility: Closed/incomplete order and blocked-status integration regressions, including generated status/quantity cases and mutation.
failureModel.wrongCustomerOrStaleBalance: Fresh-report and customer identity tests, existing saved-search and reservation regressions.
failureModel.stockRegression: Default complete-line behavior and full return subsystem regression suite.
failureModel.unusableCustomerList: Real browser geometry checks for one, three and many results at multiple viewport widths.
failureModel.deploymentDrift: Three-way merge from task baseline onto captured live sources; validate candidate; verify hashes and health after deployment; automatic app-only rollback.
failureModel.remoteLatency: Operational timing samples; external NetSuite latency cannot be bounded by local tests.

revision2.reason: Live header query experiments were slower (3.7–19s); retain the original SO query and all eligibility behavior.
scenarios: P1 Run linked RA-credit lookup concurrently with fresh balance reads; resolve PALLET once before the concurrent work when links are needed.
P2 Preserve existing SO identity, complete line/status checks, and every fresh balance/credit reservation rule. New credits absent from the observed identity set remain reserved.
P4 No links require no extra PALLET resolution or link request. Either remote failure fails the lookup and leaves reservations unchanged.
O2 Successful SO lookups log order reference, mode and total elapsed milliseconds, without customer/contact data or credentials.
revision2.performance: Only claim timing reductions supported by matched read-only live observations; external NetSuite variance remains.
